title: BYO corpus record — fireflies
description: A Fireflies.ai meeting transcript. `channel` is the grouping unit, because a channel is Fireflies' own way of grouping meetings and is what `transcripts(channel_id:)` filters on. Field names are the API's own — `host_email`, `organizer_email`, `duration` (MINUTES), `meeting_attendees`, `summary`, `analytics` — so a corpus written against the real API needs no renaming. A transcript's `sentences` are its child rows, NOT `replies` (which is Slack-only): a transcript should read like a transcript. `content` and `sentences` are two views of the same text and are never allowed to disagree — supply `sentences` and `content` is derived from them; supply only `content` and the sentences are parsed back out of it, so a plain "Speaker: text" body still yields per-sentence rows. `transcript_id`, the media/web URLs, `speaker_id` ordinals and any missing sentence timings are derived when omitted.

title.description: The meeting title, as it would appear on the calendar invite.

content.description: The transcript body as one document — what full-text search and `keyword` with `scope: sentences` match against. Written as one `Speaker: text` line per sentence; any line that names no known speaker is treated as a continuation of the sentence above it. Derived from `sentences` when those are supplied, so it can be omitted in that case — but a record must carry one or the other, or there is no transcript to serve.

sentences.description: The transcript's utterances in order, served as `Transcript.sentences`. Each carries the speaker and its timing. When present, `content` is the concatenation of these and the pair round-trips exactly.

content.description: Alias of `text`, accepted so a sentence reads like every other child row in this format.

speaker_name.description: The speaker's display label as transcribed ("Maya Chen", or an anonymous "Speaker 2"). Null when diarization produced no label, which the real API also returns; such a sentence renders in `content` with no `Speaker: ` prefix.

speaker_id.description: Fireflies numbers speakers WITHIN one meeting. Default: an ordinal assigned by first appearance.

author_email.description: The speaker resolved to an identity. Omit for an anonymous speaker.

start_time.description: Seconds from the start of the meeting. Default: the running clock, so the sequence stays ordered.

end_time.description: Seconds from the start of the meeting. Default: the next sentence's start, or a speaking-rate estimate for the last one.

doc_id.description: Stable id (default: dsid_<sha256(source_type+title+content)>). The served `Transcript.id` is derived from it.

channel.description: The channel the meeting belongs to, e.g. "sales-calls" (default: the source_type).

group.description: ACL group owning the channel (default: slug(channel)).

transcript_id.description: The API-facing id `transcript(id:)` looks a meeting up by. Default: a 24-character hex id derived from the doc_id.

host_email.description: The meeting host. Alias of `author_email`, which is the generic field; either may be used.

host_name.description: The host's display name (default: derived from the email).

organizer_email.description: Whoever put the meeting on the calendar, when that differs from the host. Falls back to the host when absent, as it does in Fireflies.

duration.description: Meeting length in MINUTES — the unit the Fireflies API uses, not seconds.

participants.description: Participant email addresses, served as `Transcript.participants`. Default: the distinct speaker identities across the sentences.

meeting_attendees.description: Served as `Transcript.meeting_attendees` — the calendar guest list, which can name people who never spoke.

summary.description: Fireflies' auto-generated notes, served as `Transcript.summary`. Deliberately NOT folded into `content`: the API's `keyword`/`scope` filter searches the title and the sentences, so summary prose in the sentence text would make `scope: sentences` match words nobody said.

analytics.description: Served as `Transcript.analytics` (sentiments / speakers / categories). Synthesized deterministically when absent — the mock never derives sentiment from the text.

audio_url.description: Recording URL. Default: derived from the transcript id. The mock serves the URL, never the media bytes.

video_url.description: Recording URL. Default: derived from the transcript id. The mock serves the URL, never the media bytes.

transcript_url.description: The meeting's page in the Fireflies web app. Default: derived from the transcript id.

meeting_link.description: The conferencing link the meeting was recorded from. Default: derived from the doc_id.

calendar_id.description: The calendar-side id of the meeting.

calendar_type.description: Which calendar the meeting came from (default: google_calendar).

visibility.description: public = org-wide, group = the channel's group, private = host only.

readers.description: Explicit reader principals. `user:<email>` / `group:<id>` / `org:<name>` state the type; unprefixed, an address is a user and anything else a group. Overrides visibility — and an EMPTY array means nobody may read the document (admin-only), not everybody.

meta.description: Free-form per-source structured extras merged into the record.

created.description: When the meeting was recorded, served as `Transcript.date` (epoch seconds or ISO 8601). Default: synthesized from doc_id.
